author: PlayStation
description:
The UEFA Champions League Challenge is live on PlayStation® Tournaments in EA SPORTS FC™ 27. Tournaments are available throughout the season, giving FC 27 players on PS5® more opportunities to enter, compete and chase the win.

How to play:
 • Open EA SPORTS FC™ 27 on PS5®
 • Go to PlayStation® Tournaments
 • Select the UEFA Champions League Challenge
 • Register and compete

The biggest rewards come as the season progresses, with opportunities to compete for prizes and bigger experiences throughout the UEFA Champions League Challenge.

Think you have what it takes? Start your Champions League journey.

Sign up on PlayStation® Tournaments: https://www.playstation.com/en-us/tournaments/
